full_judgment:
2. The facts, in short, as stated in the petition, are that, the petitioner had been the Chief Security Officer of Mongla Port Authority since 1994. He joined Pakistan Navy in 1965 as Patrolman. After independence of Bangladesh he joined Bangladesh Navy. Thereafter in 1974 he joined Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Corporation as TraveIling Inspector. In 1978 he joined Mongla Port Authority as Assistant Secretary of Estate. In 1984 he was promoted to Deputy Secretary of the said Port Authority. In 1990 he was promoted to Senior Deputy Secretary. Lastly, he was promoted to Manager, Administration, and was posted as the Chief Security Officer of the Port. While the petitioner had been serving for the last thirty years with sincerity and honesty, he received an order dated 5-8-95 passed by respondent No.1 suspending him from service with effect from 6-8-95 (Annexure-A). 

 4. On 11-9-95 the respondent No. 1 constituted an Enquiry Committee consisting of Member (Operation) and Chief Engineer (Civil & Hydraulic) of the Port Authority to hold enquiry and to submit report by 12-10-95. The report was submitted to the respondent No. 1 on 20-11-95 (Annexure-D). On 3-12-95 the respondent No. 1 issued second show cause notice upon the petitioner (Annexure-E) and on 9-12-95 the petitioner submitted his reply (Annexure-F). The respondent No. 1 passed the impugned order on 6-2-96 of compulsory retirement of the petitioner with retrospective effect from 6-8-95 (Annexure-G). 

 10. Mr Nurul Islam, the learned Advocate by referring to Regulation 41(2) of the Mongla Port Authority Regulation 1991 has submitted that to carry out an enquiry against an employee, chargesheeted for any alleged offence, an enquiry committee consisting of three members, holding position not below the rank of the accused employee should be formed. But from the enquiry committee report dated 12-10-95 it may be found that the enquiry was held by a two-member committee consisting of Member (Operation) and the Chief Engineer (Civil) and Hydraulic), as the report bears the signature of these two persons only. Therefore, the learned Advocate submits that the enquiry was concluded not by a legally formed committee.
